title: nothing published in 14d was accepted: 17 measured post(s), 0 like(s), 0 comment(s), 0 save(s)
evidence: 20 post(s) published in the last 14d, 17 with insights collected; totals over the measured set: likes=0 comments=0 saves=0 reach=47 (mean reach 2.8/post). The harness is producing normally -- renders complete, posts land, the queue holds at target -- so every machine-level check stays green while the RESULT is zero. This is the acceptance counter for the 2026-09-28 GO/PIVOT/KILL gate; a flat engagement read there is this condition, not a starved pipeline. notes.note: 2026-09-22 08:4xZ ops-triage: DECIDED + TRACKED, and the check that files it is new in-repo this pass. Root cause of the blind spot: every other check on this board measures the MACHINE (renders, captions, queue, VRAM, publish liveness) and none measured the RESULT, so a harness can render one image an hour and publish 3/day into an audience that never engages while every surface reads green. New: bin/tc_ops.py check_engagement_acceptance (registered in CHECKS, pure verdict engagement_acceptance_verdict + 9 selftest cases, suite 301 assertions / 0 failures) -- trailing 14d window, counts ONLY posts whose insights were actually collected (missing data must never read as zero acceptance), floor of 10 measured posts, zero is the bound (no threshold to defend later), probe-owned so it self-closes on the first engaged post. MEASURED at filing: 20 posts published in 14d, 17 measured, likes=0 comments=0 saves=0 reach=47 (mean 2.8/post). Longer series from scheduling_posts: Sep 36 posts / 0 likes / 3.5 reach per post; Aug 49 / 1 like / 3.5; Feb 14 / 5 likes / 14.7. DECISION: keep cadence and keep publishing -- no code change makes an audience engage, and the strategy call belongs to the pre-registered 2026-09-28 GO/PIVOT/KILL gate, which now reads this number continuously instead of reconstructing it. NOT done on purpose: no change to Growth::WeeklyReview's per-pillar metric before the gate. Its mean-of-per-post-rates is noise-dominated at this account's reach (one like on a 5-reach post reads 20.0% and lifts a pillar's average), but the gate criterion 'no pillar above 3% average engagement' fails under BOTH readings (max 2.22% mean-of-rates; aggregate rates are lower), so the verdict cannot flip and re-deriving a pre-registered gate's input mid-window would be moving the goalposts. The review already reports raw likes/reach/saves per pillar, so the 09-28 reading can use counts.

2026-09-22 09:4xZ ops-triage: the counter added last pass is verified live and the decision stands. bin/tc_ops.py selftest -> 301 assertions, 0 failures; this tick the probe re-read the window (seen 2x) with the same verdict (17 measured posts, 0 likes/comments/saves). Deliberately LEFT OPEN: it is the 2026-09-28 gate acceptance counter and it self-closes on the first engaged post -- a manual close would be re-opened by the next probe from the same window, so closing it by hand is noise, not a resolution. No code change makes an audience engage; the strategy call stays with the pre-registered gate.
